visual_review.reviewer: assistant visual inspection of native Blender renders
observations: Six orthographic views show the sloped roof, crowned head and curved palm profile; front/rear retain a visible assembly split.
Fixed-camera before/after hero shows tapered fluted chuck, torque flutes, broader grip with nine ribs and perimeter, trigger grooves and battery side covers.
Reflection stripes improve the vent rim shading but expose local curvature variation around fixed fastener neighborhoods. No Class-A fairness claim.
Top and rear views retain bright interruptions inside the intentional 0.8 mm shell split; seam closure/light blocking remains a later design task.
Trigger close-up retains faceted groove highlights; shrouds and rear cover remain simple forms. These are refinement limits, not resolved defects.
Topology images show real local edge reconstruction. Unselected polygon layout is retained; the result is mixed polygons and triangles, not a quad cage.
Curvature colors use a fixed 0.15 maximum; sharp feature and cut boundaries dominate high values. This is descriptive evidence, not a global fairness score.
visual_review.limits: Original procedural design. Visual review is qualitative; no measured manufacturer likeness or photorealism claim.

limits: Original authored model, not a manufacturer replica or manufacturing certification.
Discrete collision and sampled error/clearance; no continuous collision or strength proof.
Mixed polygon/triangle patch reconstruction; arbitrary seam-crossing or quad retopology unsupported.
A later parameter update regenerates the procedural root, not arbitrary hand edits; prior objects/files remain preserved.
Visible fixed-land curvature, split light leaks and faceted groove highlights remain; no Class-A or photorealism claim.
